name: Celadon Gym (Rainbow Badge Duel)
summary: Snip the outer hedge shrub with the Shears tool to enter the botanical greenhouse of Celadon Gym. Navigate the winding floral corridors, defeat Erika's apprentices, and initiate the formal 3 vs 3 duel against Gym Leader Erika under the Hard Mode Level 39 cap.

items.name: Rainbow Badge
items.method: Awarded by Gym Leader Erika upon defeat (controls Pokémon up to Lv. 50)

items.name: TM22 Solar Beam
items.method: Gift from Gym Leader Erika after winning the gym duel

items.name: Red Headband
items.method: Gift from Gym Leader Erika after winning the gym duel
